title: Opening a shared URL or bookmark loads the page with those filters on
refs: Filters (no Jira epic) (S11-R2; §2 Feature Overview (share or bookmark)) [spec v1.6 2026-07-28]
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You have copied a Work Orders URL that was produced with filters applied (for example Status: Approved + one customer).
custom_steps:
1. Open the copied URL in a new browser tab (same signed-in user).
2. Look at the chips and the table as the page loads.
custom_expected:
1. The page opens with the same filters already applied - chips active with the same values.
2. The table is already filtered accordingly on load (no need to re-apply anything).
3. The same works from a saved bookmark.
